records.purpose: Add delta to one named stat of your own player through the game's stat-adjust function; the game clamps it and applies its own consequences. *out_after (may be NULL) is the stat read back right after the write. A change the game would discard (no authority, no local change allowed) is refused, never a silent OK.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*adjust)(sco_plugin* self, uint64_t id, uint32_t stat, float delta, float* out_after);`
Add delta to one named stat of your own player through the game's stat-adjust function; the game clamps it and applies its own consequences. *out_after (may be NULL) is the stat read back right after the write. A change the game would discard (no authority, no local change allowed) is refused, never a silent OK.
records.ownership: Copied scalar inputs; one float or uint32 copied out when the out pointer is set; no allocation, no engine pointer transfer, nothing retained. No lease: a write is a one-shot game adjust.
records.thread_affinity: Game thread only; WRONG_THREAD elsewhere before any game access.
records.reentrancy: Calls the game's own stat-adjust function at most once under a fault guard; no plugin re-entry.
records.results: OK applied and read back; BAD_ARG null or released self, id 0 or not your player, stat not a 1.0 stat, a non-finite input or a step past SC_ACTOR_STATS_WRITE_MAX_STEP; NOT_FOUND not spawned or no record of that stat; UNAVAILABLE game.actor_stats.write off, no fresh offline admission, or mode DISCARDED (the game would ignore the change); FAILED game fault or no read-back; WRONG_THREAD off the game thread.
records.absent_capability: Table absent: query_service NOT_FOUND. game.actor_stats.write is OFF by default (product switch or SCO_ACTOR_STATS_WRITE=1, plus its rows and game.actor_stats.read); while it is off, or (adjust, set) the session is not certified offline, the answer is UNAVAILABLE.
records.cleanup: Nothing is restored on unload: the stats are gameplay state the game changes every tick. game.actors' stop withdraws the table and clears the capability.
limitations: Static evidence on 4.10.197.2878 (F-4.10.197.2878-010); not run in game.
Whether a write persists in an offline session (in particular a LOCAL_ONLY one) is not known; capability OFF.
The game ignores hunger, thirst and blood-drug changes while their pl_status.enable* switch is off; out_after shows it.
Your own player only in 1.0; no C# or Lua route.
